_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 18 min cuts strobe 0.00220 to 0.00214 and traces Trafalgar and Dundas end to end; lines stay thin, no white
_why.TRAIL_SHOULDER_W: 8 px shoulder drops the haze pooled round Oakville GO at 1:1; corridors and dots read the same, strobe equal
_why.BUS_HALO_R: 6 px halo keeps the 2.2 px dots readable and tightens the blob at Oakville GO; strobe 0.00214 to 0.00213
_why.day.BUS_HALO_ALPHA: 0.07 halo still leaves 2.2 px dots clear after the round trip, with less glow at stops; strobe 0.00213 to 0.00211
_why.rush.FRAME_ZOOM: 0.9 shows more of the city and hides fewer buses under the panel (safe share 0.82 vs 0.78); all arms crop the south
_why.rush.FRAME_DX_KM: -1.1 km brings Bronte and Third Line into frame, safe share 0.84 vs 0.82; the east tip is lake shore above the buttons
_why.rush.FRAME_DY_KM: -1.1 km lifts the south shore out from under the panel, safe share 0.88, only the empty north tip nears the title
_why.rush.PANEL_ALPHA: the city line crosses the credit on the rush close-up; 1.15 lifts credit2 contrast from 3.6 to 4.6, over the 4.5 limit
